title: Cantilever beam
sentence: A steel cantilever under a tip load — the first model to build, and the standard check against beam theory.
theory: A tip-loaded cantilever deflects $\delta = \dfrac{PL^3}{3EI}$, with $I = \dfrac{bh^3}{12}$ for a rectangular section. Here $L = 1\,\mathrm{m}$, $P = 1\,\mathrm{kN}$, $E = 210\,\mathrm{GPa}$ and $b = h = 100\,\mathrm{mm}$, so $I = 8.333\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{m^4}$ and $\delta = 0.1905\,\mathrm{mm}$.
